general_information.name: OH—MY FULL LEGAL NAME… I THINK IT’S ELEANOR HAYWOOD. THAT’S HOW IT APPEARS ON MY DOCUMENTS, YES.
general_information.gender: Sorry, do you mean how it should be written down, like on a form? I’m getting myself mixed up a bit today.
general_information.address: It’s 155 Balliol Street… in Toronto, Ontario.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been kind of hard to sort out because it all feels tangled together, but mostly I’ve had this low mood for… well, years, really, and I keep feeling this heavy worry that I’m going to end up like my father did. He died by suicide when I was twelve, and that hangs over me a lot. I don’t have thoughts of doing that myself, though — I don’t.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to stop feeling like my father’s death is my future… and maybe not carry that around so much. Also, I want to break the pattern for my own daughter, I guess.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto. My father died when I was 12, and after that things felt… different. As a little kid I was probably pretty quiet, I think. Or serious. I don’t know if that’s what you mean.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed school and a social work degree. I’ve always kind of seen myself as serious, I guess. Nothing else is really jumping out at me right now.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married — it’s been 15 years — and that’s current. I also have one child.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to break the pattern for my own daughter. And, I suppose, stop living with this feeling that my father’s death is somehow where I’m headed.
